1. Open ONE tab, navigate to studio.youtube.com, confirm you're on the Vibe Technologies channel (check account switcher if unsure, do NOT touch any other channel).
2. Go to Content -> Videos list (in the SAME tab, just navigate within it).
3. Find the row for jC6yB57t1Oo (title "OpenCode Mobile — AI coding agent in your pocket #Shorts"). Note its exact visibility/status column value if visible from the LIST view (don't need to open the broken edit page).

5. Re-upload the SAME source file: /tmp/ocm_short_final.mp4 (21.3s vertical short, already verified clean footage) via Create -> Upload videos, using the file input[type=file] (not drag-drop).

8. Get the new video ID / Short URL from the publish confirmation.
9. Take ONE screenshot of the publish confirmation as evidence.
10. Close the tab.

If you hit any blocker (can't find the delete option, deletion fails, wrong channel, 2FA, upload stuck again), STOP immediately and report the exact blocker — do not retry indefinitely and do not open additional tabs to "investigate" further.

Return: old video deleted (yes/no), new video ID/URL, screenshot path, confirmation tab was closed, and total tab count you observed at start vs end (to prove you didn't leave extra tabs).
